concerns.text: Both T001 and T004 are tagged [P] yet both write files under specs/001-structural-mismatch-cost/contracts/ — T001 creates the directory 'containing the source files and contract schemas referenced by other tasks' while T004 'Create/repair the data schemas in .../contracts/'. Two parallel tasks mutating the same files/directory is not parallel-safe; either scope T001 to directory scaffolding only (no schema files) or drop [P] from one and declare the dependency.

T008's executors consume the datasets fetched by T005 ('sampled/streamed MS MARCO subset', 'Spider subset', 'DBpedia/Wikidata subset' via data_fetcher), but T008's declared dependency list reads only 'Dependency: T016, T006.' Add T005 to T008's dependency declaration. (Listed order is already correct, so this is a declaration gap, not an ordering violation.)

T030 declares 'Dependency: T021, T025' but its only input is data/processed/execution_logs.csv (produced by T021); the T025 dependency is over-declared. Harmless to order, but trim for accuracy or state why the translation-error analysis must precede plotting.
